_notes: Plume reads this file every time the app opens. Edit and push to change copy, prices and pop-ups with no app update. reserve.url = your Stripe Payment Link (the reserve card and any reserve pop-up stay hidden until it is set). Pop-up fields: id (unique; change it to show again), enabled, screen (home | book | afterScan), title, body, cta, dismiss, action (reserve | book | close | url:https://...), image (https url, optional), minDrawings, maxDrawings, minDaysInstalled, start, end (YYYY-MM-DD), hideIfReserved, once (default true). One pop-up per app open, and none within cooldownDays of the last one.

reserve.head: Get the real book in June
reserve.body: A hardcover of this year's drawings, printed and shipped to your door when school lets out. Reserve now and you won't have to think about it again.
reserve.reservedNote: Reserved? You're set. We'll email you in May to pick the cover and confirm your address.

bookNote: The preview is a PDF of the whole book, free. Tap the heart on a drawing to give it its own page.

modals.title: Your year, in a real book

modals.title: Got a favorite?
modals.body: Open a drawing and tap the heart. Favorites get a whole page in the book.
